title: Target accuracy / %
description: Accuracy the budget protects, 50–100. OKs left = OKs you can still take if every other remaining note is a GREAT; a miss costs two OKs.

title: Orientation
description: auto follows the page's shape: a row for wide boxes (the 280×80 chip), a column for tall ones.

title: Alignment
description: left: gauge and budget on the left. right: mirrored, for a page on the right of the screen. center: centred in the box.

title: Motion
description: full = the gauge eases, the budget ticks down and the spent part flashes its judgement colour. reduced = the gauge and enter/exit still ease; no tick or flash. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Show what osu!'s HUD shows
description: Also show accuracy and the GREAT/OK/MISS counts, which osu!'s own HUD already shows. In the 280×80 chip these extras (with UR and pp) take the miss line's place and only what fits one line shows; a box 104 px tall or more shows both.

title: Unstable rate
description: The unstable rate (the same number as results-card).

title: pp
description: Current and if-FC pp (the same numbers as pp-counter).
